reviewer: Claude review of stored model labels, MSK requirement parts and the investigations’ 3D views; not a radiologist review
decision: On 2026-11-18 the project owner asked for the 3D models to be bound; this pass covers the MSK evidence ledger.
rule: A stored MSK model is bound to a requirement when its own source label names the structure and the requirement is the structure itself (no parts), the part that is the structure’s own body (its course, midsubstance, muscle belly, tendon substance, articular surface or bursal boundaries), a part that the label names, or a small named group or union of which the label names one member. A whole is not bound to a requirement that names its regions, bundles or components, and a part is not bound to its whole. The requirement must belong to an investigation that lists the model or shows it in its 3D view; where the view shows it but the record did not list the investigation, the investigation is added to the record. Coverage is always partial.
method: The labels of all 624 MSK models without a binding were compared with the structure and part names of the 22 MSK investigations, within the investigations that list each model or show it in their 3D view (displays). Every candidate was reviewed by hand; 147 bindings on 115 models were accepted. Every other model is listed under not_bound with its reason.
